periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis of the visible eye patch is oriented at an angle of roughly 75 degrees relative to the horizontal axis of the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: The eye patch is an elongated oval with a vertical-to-horizontal ratio of approximately 2:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: The patch exhibits a slight downward taper, creating a teardrop-shaped lower margin.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are separated by a distinct section of white fur roughly equal to the width of the individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior edges of the ears are smooth and follow a consistent semicircular curve.

other_distinctive_markers: Exposure of the upper and lower teeth is visible during the mastication of bamboo stalks.
